messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [constraint] The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11)
- [constraint] The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, the peak season. (since 2025-11-11; source standup/atlas/2025-11-11)
- [constraint] The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. (since 2025-04-22; source standup/cinder/2025-04-22)
- The Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. (since 2026-05-28; source standup/ember/2026-05-28)
- [constraint] The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. (since 2025-08-25; source standup/atlas/2025-08-25)
  - earlier: [constraint] The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. (held 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; source standup/atlas/2025-01-14)
- [decision] As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. (since 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-07-30)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. (held 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-06-19)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. (held 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; source standup/atlas/2025-05-13)
  - earlier: [decision] Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call for the Atlas team; Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team this cycle as of 2025-04-03. (held 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; source standup/atlas/2025-04-03)
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- The ledger service is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged the ledger service. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- The Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. (since 2025-01-09; source standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2)
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. (since 2025-03-04; source standup/atlas/2025-03-04)
- Team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the reporting service's owners. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-2)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- [decision] The Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. (since 2026-02-03; source standup/atlas/2026-02-03)
- [decision] Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. (since 2025-05-22; source standup/boreal/2025-05-22)
- Farah is the release captain for Q3 2025. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-3)
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. (since 2025-04-24; source standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2)
